selection_scope: contrasts requested after observing BASE; no new arm or threshold fit
limitations: Conditional on this BASE checkpoint, fixed B split and fitted heads; no LoRA/head fitting variance.
Dev threshold selection uses the same permitted procedure for every arm and no outer labels; those pipeline gains are valid conditional comparisons.
Fixed 0.5 is an alternative exploratory operating rule, not a new selected threshold; neither operating rule should be chosen post hoc for favorable scores.
Anchor contrasts change direct readout input, optimization/stopping trajectory and fitted dev thresholds together; accuracy gain is not pure representation or aggregation attribution.
Selected anchors use the same four unique layers; fixed anchors add a fifth unique layer in these BASE folds.
Joint linear and residual MLP fusion have different capacities/function families; direct comparison is predictive evidence, not an isolated optimization causal test.
Layer depth and attention type are confounded; best_single means linear-probe-selected layer followed by MLP, not exhaustive best MLP.
BCE/Brier/AUROC are descriptive point estimates here; accuracy/F1 contrast CIs use whole groups.
Incomplete adapted caches cannot support pre/post-LoRA or mean/last conclusions.
